My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
Carriers sometimes mark packages as delivered slightly before actual drop-off, or they may be left in an discreet location.
First, please check with neighbors, household members, and nearby spots around your property such as porches, mailboxes, or building offices.
If you still can't locate the package after 24 hours, email support@renuebyscience
